name: Agarwal Toughened Glass India Ltd
about: Incorporated in October 2009, Agarwal Toughened Glass India Limited manufactures tempered glasses for various industries.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Agarwal Toughened Glass manufactures toughened glass for B2B and B2C markets. The company processes float glass into value-added toughened glass products, which cater to sectors like construction, automotive, and industrial applications.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 33.2%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 118 days to 251 days
